videos.title: The high cost of cheap intelligence | David Ajibade | TEDxFUHSO
videos.summary: This thought-provoking TEDx talk explores how relying on cheap artificial intelligence can unknowingly erode human critical thinking, confidence, and genuine expertise. Speaker David Ajibade breaks down the 'Expensive Human' framework, explaining why human taste, judgment, and accountability are essential traits that AI can never replace.

timestamps.topic: The Three Superpowers of Artificial Intelligence
Why External Intelligence Weakens Human Confidence
The Critical Difference Between Intelligence, Wisdom, and Confidence
The 'Expensive Human' Framework: Taste, Judgement, and Accountability

videos.title: From Fracking to AI: How to Share the Next Boom | Daniel Ketyer | TEDxDuke
videos.summary: In this compelling TEDx talk, energy investor Daniel Ketyer draws lessons from the Appalachian fracking boom to navigate the massive economic and infrastructure surge driven by AI data centers. He outlines how high capital investment often fails to create local wealth and proposes actionable solutions—such as streamlined clean energy permitting and community equity models—to ensure local communities share in AI's prosperity.

timestamps.topic: The Hidden Costs of Technological Booms
Comparing Fracking to the AI Data Center Expansion
Two Solutions for Equity in the AI Era

videos.title: Build for the Memo, Not the Demo — Shawn Chan, China Resources Holdings
videos.summary: AI tools often excel at shallow, impressive demos but crumble when subjected to the high-stakes, skeptical scrutiny of real investment committees. Drawing from 15 years in cross-border finance and over 200 investment committees, Shawn Chan outlines how to bridge the gap between catchy AI demos and rigorous 'memo-ready' systems that earn actual investor trust.

timestamps.topic: The Demo vs. The Memo: Two Different AI Machines
Six Ways Trust Quietly Breaks in AI Financial Products
The Fix: 5 Essential Rules to Build Trustworthy AI Systems

videos.title: Let's integrate AI Agents in Event-Sourced Systems — Divakar Kumar, FlyersSoft
videos.summary: This talk demonstrates how combining AI agents with event-sourced architectures can solve complex, real-time fraud detection challenges where traditional rule-based and standard ML models fall short. By leveraging materialized view projections across separate bounded domains, multi-agent systems can gather full contextual data to make intelligent decisions on edge-case transactions in sub-500ms response times.

timestamps.topic: The Hybrid Tier-1 vs Tier-2 Fraud Detection Strategy
Building a Materialized Semantic Layer Across Bounded Contexts
Multi-Agent Fan-Out Orchestration and Consensus Voting

videos.title: Wearing the Agent: From Group Chats to Glasses — Sai Krishna Rallabandi
videos.summary: Discover how AI is evolving beyond 1-on-1 personal assistants into shared group chat participants and wearable devices like smart glasses. This talk breaks down the essential engineering harness required—focusing on runtime security, intelligent long-term memory, and context-aware privacy routing—to build reliable multi-user AI agents. It's a must-watch for developers looking to build the next generation of ambient, collaborative artificial intelligence.

timestamps.topic: The Shift from Single-Person to Group-Based AI Agents
Securing AI Agents Against Indirect Prompt Injections
Managing Long-Term Memory and Context in Shared AI Systems

videos.title: How to turn your worst fears into advantages #shorts #tedx
videos.summary: This inspiring talk introduces the 'pre-mortem' strategy—a powerful technique borrowed from business to face your worst-case scenarios head-on. By intentionally imagining failure in advance and mapping out a comeback, you can demystify fear and gain the mental clarity needed to make bold life choices.

timestamps.topic: The 'Pre-Mortem' Method Explained

videos.title: Back to Black Roxbury: Creating a Cycle of Generational Wealth | Dianne Wilkerson | TEDxRoxbury

She shares powerful stories of past displacement and outlines an innovative strategic plan to preserve community wealth by empowering local seniors and young homebuyers.

timestamps.topic: The Historical Impact of Infrastructure Projects on Roxbury

videos.title: How Forward Deployed Engineering is done at Factory — Eno Reyes
videos.summary: In this insightful presentation from the AI Engineer World's Fair, Factory co-founder and CTO Eno Reyes redefines the role of Forward Deployed Engineers in the age of AI. Instead of working as traditional software consultants, Reyes explains how deployed engineers install autonomous 'software factory' systems and prepare enterprise codebases to be 'agent-ready.' It's a must-watch for engineering leaders seeking to move beyond simple AI coding assistants toward fully autonomous engineering workflows.

timestamps.topic: Reframing Deployed Engineering: Software Factories vs. Services

videos.title: How Forward Deployed Engineering is done at Cognition — Jia Wu
videos.summary: Discover how Cognition transforms AI coding hype into real-world enterprise impact by leveraging Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to deeply embed their AI software engineer, Devin, into complex software development lifecycles. Featuring real-world case studies from major banks and fintechs, this talk demonstrates how aligning AI capabilities directly with customer problems slashes development cycle times by over 80% and delivers massive productivity gains.

videos.title: Expose your site's actions to AI agents using WebMCP
videos.summary: Tired of AI agents misinterpreting web interfaces and clicking the wrong buttons? This video introduces WebMCP, a new web standard allowing websites to explicitly define and expose their capabilities directly to AI agents using simple schemas. Watch to learn how this shift from visual guessing to structured action makes web automation reliable and robust.

timestamps.topic: Registering Tools using WebMCP and JavaScript Schemas
